All submitted documents must meet the following criteria:

Documents must be written in the target language (Indonesian).

Each document must contain at least 300 words.

Documents must have a natural, meaningful, and readable structure.

Each document must contain at least 2 structural elements, such as:

Tables

Key-value fields

Signatures

Figures or images

Clickable fields

Text sections or headings

Lists, columns, or form fields

Documents must be authentic and publicly available online.

A valid source URL must be provided for every submitted document.

The actual document must be downloadable in PDF, JPG, PNG, or another suitable file format.

Webpage screenshots, screen captures, browser snapshots, or text snippets are not acceptable as final submissions.

Documents must be clearly identifiable as being written in Indonesian.

Documents must be complete, legible, and of reasonable quality.

Avoid duplicate documents, irrelevant content, or files with incomplete pages.

Preferred Document Types

We are looking for documents across a wide range of domains, including but not limited to:

Loans and mortgage documents

Newspapers and news articles

Legal documents and official notices

Contracts and agreements

Financial reports

Environmental reports

Tax documents

Handwritten doctor's notes

Handwritten applications

Receipts and invoices

Certificates of analysis

Insurance documents

Hospital claims and patient forms

Checks and deposit slips

Educational documents and academic reports

Government forms and public administration records

Business letters and correspondence

Manuals, guides, and informational brochures

Domain-Based Sourcing

We will provide a list of specific domain names/websites from which documents must be sourced.

Freelancers must search within the assigned domains and identify documents that meet all project requirements.

Documents must be sourced only from the provided domains unless additional sources are explicitly approved.

Important Guidelines

The focus is on sourcing real documents, not creating or translating documents.

Documents must come from legitimate public sources or accessible document repositories within the assigned domains.

Each submission must include the original source URL for verification.

Do not submit artificially generated, recreated, or manually assembled documents.

Do not combine content from multiple documents to meet the word-count requirement.

For multi-page documents, one self-contained page may be selected, provided it independently meets all requirements.

Ensure the document is readable, properly formatted, and clearly in the target language before submitting.

Do not source private, confidential, or sensitive personal information.

Duplicate documents or previously submitted files will not be accepted.

Payment

$2 per approved document

Payment is provided for documents that pass quality review and meet all project requirements.

Rejected or non-compliant submissions will not be eligible for payment.

Accuracy, authenticity, language quality, and compliance with the sourcing guidelines are essential for approval.

Project Duration

This is an ongoing project with recurring batches of work. Freelancers who deliver consistent, high-quality submissions may be invited to participate in future batches.
